[and]-:C22 atha śrītantrāloke dvāviṃśatitamamāhnikam liṅgoddhārākhyāmatha vacmaḥ śivaśāsanaikanirdiṣṭām uktaṃ śrīmālinītantre kila pārthivadhāraṇām / uktvā yo yojito yatra sa tasmānna nivartate yogyatāvaśasaṃjātā yasya yatraiva śāsanā / sa tatraiva niyoktavyo dīkṣākāle tatastvasau phalaṃ sarvaṃ samāsādya śive yukto@pavṛjyate / ayukto@pyūrdhvasaṃśuddhiṃ saṃprāpya bhuvaneśataḥ śuddhaḥ śivatvamāyāti dagdhasaṃsārabandhanaḥ / uktvā puṃdhāraṇāṃ coktametadvaidāntikaṃ mayā kapilāya purā proktaṃ prathame paṭale tathā / anena kramayogena saṃprāptaḥ paramaṃ padam na bhūyaḥ paśutāmeti śuddhe svātmani tiṣṭhati / ato hi dhvanyate@rtho@yaṃ śivatattvādhareṣvapi tattveṣu yojitasyāsti punaruddharaṇīyatā / samastaśāstrakathitavastuvaiviktyadāyinaḥ śivāgamasya sarvebhyo@pyāgamebhyo viśiṣṭatā / śivajñānena ca vinā bhūyo@pi paśutodbhavaḥ kramaśca śaktisaṃpāto malahāniryiyāsutā / dīkṣā bodho heyahānirupādeyalayātmatā

## tal-a22-p01–p05 — ahnika 22
**SUMMARY.** [and]-:C22 atha śrītantrāloke dvāviṃśatitamamāhnikam liṅgoddhārākhyāmatha vacmaḥ śivaśāsanaikanirdiṣṭām uktaṃ śrīmālinītantre kila pārthivadhāraṇām / uktvā yo yojito yatra sa tasmānna nivartate yogyatāvaśasaṃjātā yasya yatraiva śāsanā / sa tatraiva niyoktavyo dīkṣākāle tatastvasau phalaṃ sarvaṃ samāsādya śive yukto@pavṛjyate / ayukto@pyūrdhvasaṃśuddhiṃ saṃprāpya bhuvaneśataḥ śuddhaḥ śivatvamāyāti dagdhasaṃsārabandhanaḥ / uktvā puṃdhāraṇāṃ coktametadvaidāntikaṃ mayā kapilāya purā proktaṃ prathame paṭale tathā / anena kramayogena saṃprāptaḥ paramaṃ padam na bhūyaḥ paśutāmeti śuddhe svātmani tiṣṭhati / ato hi dhvanyate@rtho@yaṃ śivatattvādhareṣvapi tattveṣu yojitasyāsti punaruddharaṇīyatā / samastaśāstrakathitavastuvaiviktyadāyinaḥ śivāgamasya sarvebhyo@pyāgamebhyo viśiṣṭatā / śivajñānena ca vinā bhūyo@pi paśutodbhavaḥ kramaśca śaktisaṃpāto malahāniryiyāsutā / dīkṣā bodho heyahānirupādeyalayātmatā [and]-bhogyatvapāśavatyāgaḥ patikartṛtvasaṃkṣayaḥ / svātmasthitiścetyevaṃ hi darśanāntarasaṃsthiteḥ proktamuddharaṇīyatvaṃ śivaśaktīritasya hi / atha vaiṣṇavabauddhāditantrāntādharavartinām yadā śivārkaraśmyoghairvikāsi hṛdayāmbujam / liṅgoddhṛtistadā pūrvaṃ dīkṣākarma tataḥ param prāgliṅgāntarasaṃstho@pi dīkṣātaḥ śivatāṃ vrajet / tatropavāsya taṃ cānyadine sādhāramantrataḥ sthaṇḍile pūjayitveśaṃ śrāvayettasya vartanīm / eṣa prāgabhavalliṅgī coditastvadhunā tvayā prasannena tadetasmai kuru samyaganugraham / svaliṅgatyāgaśaṅkotthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ ca māsya bhūt acirāttvanmayībhūya bhogaṃ mokṣaṃ prapadyatām / evamastvityathājñāṃ ca gṛhīrvā vratamasya tat apāsyāmbhasi nikṣipya snapayedanurūpataḥ / snātaṃ saṃprokṣayedarghapātrāmbhobhiranantaram pañcagavyaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ tatastasmai samarpayet / tatastaṃ baddhanetraṃ ca praveśya praṇipātayet praṇavo mātṛkā māyā vyomavyāpī ṣaḍakṣaraḥ / bahurūpo@tha netrākhyaḥ sapta sādhāraṇā amī [and]-teṣāṃ madhyādekatamaṃ mantramasmai samarpayet / so@pyahorātramevainaṃ japedalpabhugapyabhuk mantramasmai samarpyātha sādhāravidhisaṃskṛte / vahnau tarpitatanmantre vrataśuddhiṃ samācaret pūjitenaiva mantreṇa kṛtvā nāmāsya saṃpuṭam / prāyaścittaṃ śodhayāmi phaṭsvāhetyūhayogataḥ śataṃ sahasraṃ vā hutvā punaḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ tathā / prayogādvauṣaḍantāṃ ca kṣiptvāhūya vrateśvaram tāro vrateśvarāyeti namaścetyenamarcayet / śrāvayecca tvayā nāsya kāryaṃ kiṃcicchivājñayā tato vrateśvarastarpyaḥ svāhāntena tataśca saḥ / kṣamayitvā visṛjyaḥ syāttato@gneśca visarjanam tacchrāvaṇaṃ ca devāya kṣamasveti visarjanam / tatastṛtīyadivase prāgvatsarvo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ adhivāsādikaḥ sveṣṭadīkṣākarmāvasānakaḥ / prāgliṅgināṃ mokṣadīkṣā sādhikāravivarjitā sādhakācāryatāmārge na yogyāste punarbhuvaḥ / punarbhuvo@pi jñāneddhā bhavanti gurutāspadam mokṣāyaiva na bhogāya bhogāyāpyabhyupāyataḥ / ityuktavānsvapaddhatyāmīśānaśivadaiśikaḥ [and]-śrīdevyā yāmalīyoktitattvasamyakpravedakaḥ / gurvantasyāpyadhodṛṣṭiśāyinaḥ saṃskriyāmimām kṛtvā rahasyaṃ kathayennānyathā kāmike kila / anyatantrābhiṣikte@pi rahasyaṃ na prakāśayet svatantrastho@pi gurvanto gurumajñamupāśritaḥ / tatra paścādanāśvastastatrāpi vidhimācaret ajñācāryamukhāyātaṃ nirvīryaṃ mantrameṣa yat / japtavānsa guruścātra nādhikāryuktadūṣaṇāt tato@sya śuddhiṃ prākkṛtvā tato dīkṣāṃ samācaret / adhodarśanasaṃsthena guruṇā dīkṣitaḥ purā tīvraśaktivaśātpaścādyadā gacchetsa sadgurum / tadāpyasya śiśorevaṃ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā sa sadguruḥ dīkṣādikarma nikhilaṃ kuryāduktavidhānataḥ / prāpto@pi sadgururyogyabhāvamasya na vetti cet vijñānadāne tacchiṣyo yogyatāṃ darśayennijām / sarvathā tvabruvanneṣa bruvāṇo vā viparyayam ajño vastuta eveti tattyaktvetthaṃ vidhiṃ caret / na tirobhāvaśaṅkātra kartavyā buddhiśālinā adhaḥspṛktvaṃ tirobhūtirnordhvopāyavivecanam / siddhānte dīkṣitāstantre daśāṣṭādaśabhedini [and]-bhairavīye catuḥṣaṣṭau tānpaśūndīkṣayettrike / siddhavīrāvalīsāre bhairavīye kule@pi ca pañcadīkṣākramopāttā dīkṣānuttarasaṃjñitā / tena sarvo@dharastho@pi liṅgoddhṛtyānugṛhyate yo@pi hṛtsthamaheśānacodanātaḥ suvistṛtam / śāstrajñānaṃ samanvicchetso@pi yāyādbahūngurūn taddīkṣāścāpi gṛhṇīyādabhiṣecanapaścimāḥ / jñānopodbalikāstā hi tattajjñānavatā kṛtāḥ uktaṃ ca śrīmate śāstre tatra tatra ca bhūyasā / āmodārthī yathā bhṛṅgaḥ puṣpātpuṣpāntaraṃ vrajet vijñānārthī tathā śiṣyo gurorgurvantaraṃ tviti / gurūṇāṃ bhūyasāṃ madhye yato vijñānamuttamam prāptaṃ so@sya gururdīkṣā nātra mukhyā hi saṃvidi / sarvajñānanidhānaṃ tu guruṃ saṃprāpya susthitaḥ tamevārādhayeddhīmāṃstattajjijñāsanonmukhaḥ / iti dīkṣāvidhiḥ prokto liṅgoddharaṇapaścimaḥ

## tal-a22-p03 (22.21-22.30)
[and]-teṣāṃ madhyādekatamaṃ mantramasmai samarpayet / so@pyahorātramevainaṃ japedalpabhugapyabhuk mantramasmai samarpyātha sādhāravidhisaṃskṛte / vahnau tarpitatanmantre vrataśuddhiṃ samācaret pūjitenaiva mantreṇa kṛtvā nāmāsya saṃpuṭam / prāyaścittaṃ śodhayāmi phaṭsvāhetyūhayogataḥ śataṃ sahasraṃ vā hutvā punaḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ tathā / prayogādvauṣaḍantāṃ ca kṣiptvāhūya vrateśvaram tāro vrateśvarāyeti namaścetyenamarcayet / śrāvayecca tvayā nāsya kāryaṃ kiṃcicchivājñayā tato vrateśvarastarpyaḥ svāhāntena tataśca saḥ / kṣamayitvā visṛjyaḥ syāttato@gneśca visarjanam tacchrāvaṇaṃ ca devāya kṣamasveti visarjanam / tatastṛtīyadivase prāgvatsarvo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ adhivāsādikaḥ sveṣṭadīkṣākarmāvasānakaḥ / prāgliṅgināṃ mokṣadīkṣā sādhikāravivarjitā sādhakācāryatāmārge na yogyāste punarbhuvaḥ / punarbhuvo@pi jñāneddhā bhavanti gurutāspadam mokṣāyaiva na bhogāya bhogāyāpyabhyupāyataḥ / ityuktavānsvapaddhatyāmīśānaśivadaiśikaḥ

source.text: [and]-śrīdevyā yāmalīyoktitattvasamyakpravedakaḥ / gurvantasyāpyadhodṛṣṭiśāyinaḥ saṃskriyāmimām kṛtvā rahasyaṃ kathayennānyathā kāmike kila / anyatantrābhiṣikte@pi rahasyaṃ na prakāśayet svatantrastho@pi gurvanto gurumajñamupāśritaḥ / tatra paścādanāśvastastatrāpi vidhimācaret ajñācāryamukhāyātaṃ nirvīryaṃ mantrameṣa yat / japtavānsa guruścātra nādhikāryuktadūṣaṇāt tato@sya śuddhiṃ prākkṛtvā tato dīkṣāṃ samācaret / adhodarśanasaṃsthena guruṇā dīkṣitaḥ purā tīvraśaktivaśātpaścādyadā gacchetsa sadgurum / tadāpyasya śiśorevaṃ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā sa sadguruḥ dīkṣādikarma nikhilaṃ kuryāduktavidhānataḥ / prāpto@pi sadgururyogyabhāvamasya na vetti cet vijñānadāne tacchiṣyo yogyatāṃ darśayennijām / sarvathā tvabruvanneṣa bruvāṇo vā viparyayam ajño vastuta eveti tattyaktvetthaṃ vidhiṃ caret / na tirobhāvaśaṅkātra kartavyā buddhiśālinā adhaḥspṛktvaṃ tirobhūtirnordhvopāyavivecanam / siddhānte dīkṣitāstantre daśāṣṭādaśabhedini

source.text: [and]-bhairavīye catuḥṣaṣṭau tānpaśūndīkṣayettrike / siddhavīrāvalīsāre bhairavīye kule@pi ca pañcadīkṣākramopāttā dīkṣānuttarasaṃjñitā / tena sarvo@dharastho@pi liṅgoddhṛtyānugṛhyate yo@pi hṛtsthamaheśānacodanātaḥ suvistṛtam / śāstrajñānaṃ samanvicchetso@pi yāyādbahūngurūn taddīkṣāścāpi gṛhṇīyādabhiṣecanapaścimāḥ / jñānopodbalikāstā hi tattajjñānavatā kṛtāḥ uktaṃ ca śrīmate śāstre tatra tatra ca bhūyasā / āmodārthī yathā bhṛṅgaḥ puṣpātpuṣpāntaraṃ vrajet vijñānārthī tathā śiṣyo gurorgurvantaraṃ tviti / gurūṇāṃ bhūyasāṃ madhye yato vijñānamuttamam prāptaṃ so@sya gururdīkṣā nātra mukhyā hi saṃvidi / sarvajñānanidhānaṃ tu guruṃ saṃprāpya susthitaḥ tamevārādhayeddhīmāṃstattajjijñāsanonmukhaḥ / iti dīkṣāvidhiḥ prokto liṅgoddharaṇapaścimaḥ
